annotations.description: Mode in which the bot receives callback queries from buttons in messages sent by the bot. Must be one of 'default' (the field message is always used and contains an InaccessibleMessage if the message is inaccessible to the bot), 'auto' (the field inline_message_id is used instead of the field message if the message is inaccessible to the bot; the field message can still contain an inaccessible message if the message has just been deleted), or 'inline' (the field inline_message_id is always used instead of the field message).
annotations.html_description: Mode in which the bot receives callback queries from buttons in messages sent by the bot. Must be one of “default” (the field message is always used and contains an InaccessibleMessage if the message is inaccessible to the bot), “auto” (the field inline_message_id is used instead of the field message if the message is inaccessible to the bot; the field message can still contain an inaccessible message if the message has just been deleted), or “inline” (the field inline_message_id is always used instead of the field message).
annotations.rst_description: Mode in which the bot receives `callback queries <https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#callbackquery>`_ from buttons in messages sent by the bot. Must be one of 'default' (the field *message* is always used and contains an :class:`aiogram.types.inaccessible_message.InaccessibleMessage` if the message is inaccessible to the bot), 'auto' (the field *inline_message_id* is used instead of the field *message* if the message is inaccessible to the bot; the field *message* can still contain an inaccessible message if the message has just been deleted), or 'inline' (the field *inline_message_id* is always used instead of the field *message*).
annotations.name: callback_query_mode
